findings.text: The actual R753 witness is a 400 Pydantic bad request carrying input_type=ArtifactRef before ForecastOwner.run. The current source has three direct ArtifactRefModel.model_validate(CoreRef) sites plus two Core refs passed as ForecastOwnerRequest selectors. R754-r5 replaces all five with one private adapter that calls the already-exported strict normalize_artifact_ref and then ArtifactRefModel.model_validate; candidate postimage hashes match the manifest.

The adapter preserves artifact_id, kind, media_type, and manifest_profile_sha256 via the current strict schema. normalize_artifact_ref is already exported by polisyos.ir.artifacts and its existing tests cover selected-profile preservation and refusal of undeclared selectors; no public alias/schema/DTO companion is needed.

The end-to-end test now compares complete JSON selector values for model, policy, and calibration-rule refs at real ForecastOwner intake. The unchanged test contains 14 actual HTTP requests (4 GET, 10 POST; including ThreadPoolExecutor.submit(client.post)) across 6 new_reader_app consumers and retains viewer/profileless/unrooted/disabled/no-write, duplicate-intent, exact-retry, conflict, tamper-integrity, legacy refusal, and changed-heldout-outcome/reopen controls. The patch changes only these assertions in the test.

The second report conversion in _recompute_s10(report=None) is patched, but the current source has exactly one _recompute_s10 caller and it passes report and evidence. The existing fresh GET exercises the first report load, not that optional fallback. This is an unreachable/currently-unused fallback seam rather than a defect in the shared adapter; if a caller is introduced, the smallest falsifier is to exercise report=None against the real selected CAS profile and prove that the selected report is loaded.

limitations: This GO authorizes only the focused native/runtime verification wave; it is not a merge decision or an authority/calibration/currentness closure.
The test still represents controlled fixture identity and predictive-only grading; external authority remains not established.
scope: Independent virtual delta review only; no source/index/Git changes and no product imports or runtime tests.
